interface.shortDescription: Lead lists of US local businesses
interface.longDescription: Search 16M+ US places by city and category, save the matches as a list, then fill the fields you need: owners and key people with email and phone, legal entity, open/closed status, hours, website, or a custom attribute you describe in plain English. Count and preview are free; paid search and search-backed list imports charge per place. Completed field lookups may be charged without an answer. The skill sends your API key only to api.voygr.tech; CSV uploads use a presigned URL (free trial at https://app.voygr.tech). US places only.
